green.basis: Forecast market contender; 6/4 Racing Post and 15/8 Sporting Life reported as forecasts, not verified off-time SP.

blue.reason: No attributable primary grassroots selection link, named author and verified pre-race publication timestamp.

yellow.reason: No independently verified multi-user community betting consensus; unique official favourite also unconfirmed.

media.note: Media selections are not grassroots forum posts.

community.note: No qualifying primary forum posts in evidence record; absence of verified posts does not prove no discussions existed.

audit_rule: Evidence before confidence: blue/yellow cannot be unlocked via synthetic narrative or third-party summaries without indexed primary source URL, named author, and verified pre-race timestamp. Yellow additionally requires independently attributable multi-user agreement and confirmed unique favourite.
changes_scope: Research record only; does not alter badge calculation or saved paper slips.
